items.source: Callback interface that can be implemented by beans wishing to customize the ClientOptions.Builder to fine-tune its auto-configuration before it creates the ClientOptions of the LettuceClientConfiguration. To customize the entire configuration, use LettuceClientConfigurationBuilderCustomizer instead.
items.translation: 可被希望自定义ClientOptions.Builder以在创建LettuceClientConfiguration的ClientOptions之前微调其自动配置的 Bean 实现的回调接口。若要自定义整个配置，请使用LettuceClientConfigurationBuilderCustomizer代替。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
